title: Snov.io Review (2026)
intro: Snov.io is evaluated here as sales intelligence software — Sales intelligence and cold email platform for finding and verifying emails, then running sequences — positioned as a budget-friendly SMB stack with a trial, Starter and Pro published rungs, and Custom/Ultra contact-sales packaging. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s sales-intelligence methodology (contact data, prospecting, enrichment, email outreach, CRM sync, usability, reporting, value). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Snov.io when budget SMB email finding plus cold email sequencing with published Starter/Pro rungs is the primary job.
verdict: Choose Snov.io when budget SMB email finding plus cold email sequencing with published Starter/Pro rungs is the primary job. Compare Apollo for broader data+sequences, Hunter for domain-finder simplicity, Reply for deeper multichannel engagement, and Closely for LinkedIn-led outbound. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Solid email finder/verifier for SMB outbound; not positioned as the deepest enterprise mega-database.
Finder + list building for cold outreach is a first-party strength for budget SMB teams.
Useful enrichment around found emails/companies, lighter than waterfall enrichment platforms.
Cold email sequencing is a core product job — stronger execution than pure contact databases.
CRM connectors are documented for common SMB stacks; solid but not the deepest enterprise sync story.
Approachable SMB UX for finder + campaigns; credit/recipient limits need light governance.
Campaign reporting supports outbound coaching; not enterprise ABM analytics.
Starter-from-about-$39 published ladder and trial path are accessible for budget SMB buyers.

faq.question: Is Snov.io a CRM?
faq.answer: No. Snov.io is sales intelligence / prospecting software. Keep a CRM of record (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, etc.) and use Snov.io for discovery, enrichment, intent, or account prioritization as applicable.

faq.question: How is Snov.io priced?
faq.answer: Trial available; Starter from about $39/mo; Pro from about $99/mo; Custom/Ultra contact sales. No forever-free plan documented as primary entry in this pass. Confirm limits on snov.io/pricing.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Snov.io?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage.
